_comment: request-pipeline/08-planning.md, 'Subagents are full agents': the ParentType=='session' gate on steps 2+3 and RecordSkillOutcome was removed. A spawned subagent handed a clearly-complex task should now run ClassifyRequest + RoutingWorkflow itself and, on a moderate/complex task turn, get a skill_candidates row via RecordSkillOutcome — none of which happened for subagents before. The scripted plan_progress in the subagent also exercises turn_plan on a non-root turn_id.

message.content: Have a subagent run a security audit of the auth module while I take the API cleanup.

arguments.prompt: Do a thorough security audit of the authentication module: check for injection, broken authentication and session handling, secrets committed in code, and missing rate limiting on the login path. Produce a prioritized findings report with severity for each issue.

updates.intent: map the auth surface and entry points

scripted_model_responses.content: Audit complete — 3 findings: 1 critical (no login rate limit), 2 medium.
The subagent found a critical rate-limit gap on login. I'll fold that into the cleanup.
